summary: Feed s170_triple is degraded: 3 faults detected - 12.4% duplicates, VLANs 10/20 completely stripped (100% untagged), and 3.5% TCP packet drops causing incomplete sessions for NDR requiring full payload and both directions.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP/SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags - 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10 and 20 are not seen. Likely broker VLAN stripping enabled or SPAN/trunk not configured to forward/pass through VLANs 10,20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot segment or correlate traffic by VLAN 10/20, breaks tenant/zone-aware detection, lateral movement and policy violation detection fails for those segments.

recommended_fix.why: NDR profile requires VLANs 10,20 for coverage. Configure broker ingress and egress to preserve 802.1Q and ensure TAP/SPAN trunks forward VLANs 10,20 to restore segmentation.

findings.root_cause: Visibility fabric is dropping packets before NDR - 96 of 2705 TCP packets (3.5%) show gaps/retransmissions exceeding 1% threshold. Tool overload is healthy, so drops are upstream: SPAN oversubscription or packet broker buffer/egress oversubscription during bursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR with needs_full_payload=true and needs_both_directions=true cannot reassemble TCP streams, misses payload for IDS signatures, file extraction and anomaly detection, creates blind spots and false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute load across NDR pool or broker egress ports with flow-aware hashing to eliminate buffer drops and ensure complete TCP sessions reach the NDR without gaps.

findings.root_cause: Same packets delivered multiple times - 347 of 2800 packets (12.4%) are duplicates exceeding 5% threshold. Likely aggregation of overlapping SPAN/mirror sessions (ingress+egress mirrored) or multiple TAPs feeding same broker port without deduplication.
findings.impact_on_tool: Wastes 10G NDR capacity and storage, inflates flow counts and alerts, can confuse NDR stream reassembly and analytics and mask true packet drop rate.

recommended_fix.why: Enable broker deduplication to drop identical packets within a short window before delivery to NDR, restoring accurate traffic volume and freeing capacity for real traffic.
